why: a wedged browser would never be killed, so close() would wait on the page again
a close that has not finished by the grace time would count as finished and the browser would not be killed
a close that finished in time would be killed anyway
a browser that is already gone would make close() throw
a process that stays open after the kill would hold close() again
a kill that throws would make close() throw
an unreadable pid would be a pid of 0 that kill signals as the process group
